rules.when: The task depends on fresh news, current events, live public facts, or recent market and product changes.
rules.why: Grok is the preferred dispatch when current web-connected context is central to the work.

rules.when: The task is a trivial mechanical edit such as a rote rename, formatting sweep, targeted typo fix, or simple file gathering.
rules.why: Use the cheapest fast profile when the task is narrow and low ambiguity.

rules.when: The task is big-brain work: a big or ambiguous multi-file feature, a risky refactor, deep design, or work that requires holding many moving parts in mind.
rules.why: Big-brain work mixes the strongest hosted profiles at high effort and normal speed; Fable never runs fast mode or above high.

rules.when: The task is ordinary implementation, debugging, review, or test work - standard coding capacity, not merely lightweight chores.
rules.why: Kimi K2.7 Code is a strong coding model for standard implementation work; mixing it with hosted models preserves subscription capacity.
